description: Whether this computer is connected to Tag Pilot Search Console MCP: "connected" (with the device name), "waiting" (a sign-in link is open; shows the link and code again), "not_connected" (call connect) or "error" (with the next step). While a sign-in is open it waits up to 25 seconds for the approval before answering, so call it after the user says they approved, not in a fast loop.

wait.description: Wait up to 25 s for an open sign-in to complete. Default true.

name: connection_status
title: Search Console MCP connection status
